text: Education is the most powerful weapon we can use to change the world.
author: Nelson Mandela

text: The highest result of education is tolerance.
author: Helen Keller

text: Learning without thought is naught; thought without learning is dangerous.
author: Confucius
work: The Analects, II.15; translation by Leonard A. Lyall (1909)

text: All men by nature desire to know.
author: Aristotle
work: Metaphysics, I.1; translation by W. D. Ross

text: Education, therefore, is a process of living and not a preparation for future living.
author: John Dewey
work: My Pedagogic Creed, article II (1897); excerpt from a sentence beginning “I believe that…”

text: Education, then, beyond all other devices of human origin, is the great equalizer of the conditions of men.
author: Horace Mann
work: Twelfth Annual Report, Massachusetts Board of Education (1848); excerpt
